challenges.statement: The candidate payload includes 7 separate interactive components (points balance, re-engagement banner, expiring points alert, quick win card, flash reward banner, quick redeem catalogue, and tangible value card). This constitutes severe component overload and choice fatigue on a single screen view.

The combination of an expiring points alert (7 days), a live countdown timer on a flash reward banner (23:45:12), and multiple immediate redemption hooks creates a high-pressure environment that verges on aggressive conversion tactics.

releaseReasons: Component overload exceeds UI Constitution limits for simultaneous cards, risking severe cognitive load for the user.

agentMessages.summary: Holding release due to component overload (7 active components) causing potential user fatigue and cognitive overload.
